name: Coralogix
summary: Coralogix writes all parsed logs to the customer's own Amazon S3 bucket and prices logs at $0.42 per GB. Logs held in the indexed Frequent Search tier cost more, with an example rate of $1.15 per GB. A 14-day trial needs no credit card.

facts.text: Retention is configurable only for the Frequent Search tier, and the pricing page advises against keeping that data longer than 7 days. All data stays in the customer's S3 bucket.
The documentation lists eight log alert types, including threshold, anomaly detection, immediate, ratio, unique count and new value.
Log alerts can notify Slack, PagerDuty, email or custom webhooks.
Billing uses daily units worth $1.50 each, and unused units expire at the end of the term.

plans.name: Logs
plans.notes: Stored in the customer's S3 bucket. Billed through daily units of $1.50. The 14-day trial has full features and a quota of 8 units

hiddenCosts: Logs in Frequent Search cost $1.15 per GB in the page's own example, and logs in the monitoring pipeline $0.50 per GB.
Pay-as-you-go lets usage reach twice the daily plan quota, and extra usage after the plan is used up is billed at the pay-as-you-go rate.
Unused units expire and have no monetary value.
